candidates.exact_span: Alternative 8 - The percent solids of sewage sludge that contains unstabilized solids generated in a primary wastewater treatment process shall be equal to or greater than 90% based on the moisture content and total solids prior to mixing with other materials.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a numeric solids limit (≥90%) for a defined sludge subset; whether a facility/discharge falls within 'unstabilized solids generated in a primary wastewater treatment process' and how 'percent solids' is calculated from moisture/total solids determines the applicable enforceable limit for compliance comparison.

candidates.exact_span: Unstabilized solids are defined as organic materials in sewage sludge that have not been treated in either an aerobic or an anaerobic treatment process.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines the scope of Alternative 8 applicability; different readings of what counts as aerobic/anaerobic treatment or 'organic materials in sewage sludge' change whether the 90% solids limit applies to a given sludge stream.

candidates.exact_span: When cover is placed on an active surface disposal site, the methane gas concentration in the air in any structure shall not exceed 25% of the lower ex plosive limit (LEL) for methane gas during the period that the disposal site is active.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets an enforceable numeric methane limit (25% LEL) conditioned on cover placement and site activity; interpretation of 'when cover is placed', 'any structure', and 'active' affects whether the limit applies and whether associated continuous monitoring obligations are triggered.

candidates.exact_span: The concentration of methane gas in air at the property line of the surface disposal site shall not exceed the LEL for methane gas during the period that the disposal site is active.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a property-line methane limit at 100% LEL (distinct from the 25% LEL structure limit); whether the disposal site is 'active' and how 'property line' is bounded changes applicable limit selection and continuous monitoring applicability.

candidates.exact_span: Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) Test - Once/Permit Life, performed within one year from the effective date of the permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: 'Once/Permit Life' with a one-year post-effective-date window creates a non-annual monitoring expectation whose due timing and recurrence depend on permit effective date interpretation; affects whether FY2025 monitoring was required and how absent TCLP results are classified.
Declares an annual PCB monitoring obligation; whether PCB monitoring is required in FY2025 depends on applicability of this Part IV requirement to the facility's sludge/disposal activities.

candidates.exact_span: Methane Gas in covered structures on site - Continuous
candidates.computation_change_reason: Continuous monitoring obligation tied to covered on-site structures; interpretation of 'covered structures' and linkage to the conditional structure methane limit affects whether monitoring was required and how gaps in continuous data are treated.

candidates.exact_span: Methane Gas at property line - Continuous
candidates.computation_change_reason: Continuous property-line methane monitoring obligation; applicability hinges on having an active surface disposal site and definitional boundaries of the property line, affecting required monitoring and missing-evidence classification for non-numeric periods.
